# Assessment template

## Identity

Reviewer label and real session ID or unavailable; exact Submission identity; original Work Order and criteria revision; environment; review date; authoring involvement and freshness evidence.

## Initial observations

Record observations before reading the author's success narrative. State which artifacts and entry points were independently inspected.

## Critical criteria

| Criterion | PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED | Direct observation and evidence | Reproduction or missing capability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fill in | Fill in | Fill in | Fill in |

## Findings

Separate observed defects, plausible causes, and suggested repairs. Include contradictory evidence and any concern withdrawn after checking. Identify source/criteria mismatch explicitly.

## Untested areas and resource use

Name every defining criterion not exercised and why. Record available usage without inventing cost or claiming that selected samples establish whole-run behavior.

## Recommendation

Recommend accept checked scope, repair, or obtain missing evidence. This is not merge/deployment permission. Record that no source or acceptance criteria were changed during review and whether any authorized process remains alive.
